name: [upd5.4] Super Toilet Siege Defense
desc:
⚠️ WE NEED BACKUP NOW! 🚨 
The Alliance Titan is down!

This is a fan-made recreation and tribute inspired by the original game by i_amreal.
Huge credits to i_amreal for the classic original experience!

Join the group for Display Character 📺 (free)

🛠️ Defend the base against an endless, chaotic army of invading toilets. Team up, survive intense waves, 
and hold the line in this fast-paced siege defense game.

💬 The game is in active development! Please report any bugs you find, 
and leave a 👍 Like to support future updates!

Mobile Tip: If you have trouble aiming, try switching to first-person mode.

Lagging? get a FREE private server with no lag!

Note: ALL Devices fully supported!
